facts.fact: The NCAIR director says Nigeria's proposed AI Bill addresses transparency, responsibility and accountability and provides regulatory sandboxes for the risky part of AI deployment.

NGA.note: Document states no government body using AI.

facts.fact: Dr. Olubunmi Ajala of the Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics describes Nigeria's proposed Artificial Intelligence Bill, which covers sovereignty, investment and risk management; no dated step in its passage is reported.

NGA.note: Document states no sectoral AI tool.
Twin data parks are discussed as plans with no builder, funder or site named.
Only a related-story headline mentions civil servant training; the document states nothing.
No data centre in service is stated.
Bill said to cover sovereignty in general; no government data rule or hosting is stated.
No nationally owned data centre in service is stated.
Only an unsigned offer of 200MW power with no amount invested.
